questions.question: A sum of ₹10,000 amounts to ₹11,025 in 2 years at a certain rate of interest per annum, compounded annually. The rate of interest per annum is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Principal = Rs10,000 

Amount = Rs11,025 

Time = 2 years 

**Formula used:**

A = P( 1 + R/100)t 

Where ,

A = Amount 

P = Principal 

T = Time in years 

R = Rate of interest 

**Calculation:**

Here, we have P = Rs10,000 , A = Rs11,025 , T = 2 years

Now, as we know that 

A = P( 1 + R/100)t

⇒ 11025 = 10000 ( 1 + R/100)² 

⇒ 11025/10000 = (1 + R/100)²

⇒ 105/100 = 1 + R/100 

 R/100 = 105/100 - 1 

 R/100 = 5/100 

 R= 5 %

**Hence, the required rate of interest is 5%.**

questions.question: Which of the following represents a quadratic equation?
questions.solution:
**Concept used:**

An quadratic equation is always is in the form of 

ax²+ bx + c = 0 

Where coefficient of x² = a 

Co-efficient of x = b 

C is a constant number 

**Calculation:**

**Considering option (1), we have **

( x - 7) ( x + 2) = ( x - 2 ) ( x) 

⇒ x² + 2x - 7x - 14 = x² - 2x 

⇒ -3x = 14 

⇒ x = -14/3 

So, this is not in the form of quadratic equation( ax² + bx + c = 0) 

**Considering option(2),we have **

( x +2) ( x +2) ( x - 1) = x³ + 5x² + 6x + 4 

⇒ (x +2)² ( x - 1) = x³ + 5x² + 6x + 4 

⇒ [x² + 4 + 4x] ( x - 1) = x³ + 5x² + 6x + 4 

⇒ x³ + 4x + 4x² - x² - 4 - 4x = x³ + 5x² + 6x + 4 

⇒ 2x² + 6x + 8 = 0 

⇒ x² + 3x + 4 = 0 

This is in the form of ax² + bx + c = 0 

Where a = 1 b = 3 and c = 4 

So, this represents the quadratic equation 

**On considering option(3), we have **

(3x + 4)x = 3x² + 16 

⇒ 3x² + 4x = 3x² + 16 

⇒ 4x = 16 ⇔ x = 4 

So, this is not in the form of ax² + bx + c = 0 

**On considering option (4), we have **

(x + 3) ( x- 4) = x² + 2x + 12 

⇒ x² - 4x + 3x - 12 = x² + 2x + 12 

⇒ 3x = 24 ⇔ x = 8 

So, this equation is also not in the form of ax² + bx + c = 0 

**Hence, option (2) represents the required quadratic equation .**

__
 
• **An adult human breathes 15 to 18 times per minute on average while at rest. **However, the rate of breathing might vary depending on the circumstances.
 
• When we are working, we breathe more quickly. As a result, the cells can receive enough oxygen as the breathing rate increases with the intensity of the task.
 
• Approximately **12 to 16 breaths per minute are taken by a healthy adult, according to the University of Rochester Medical Center.**
 
• **Children breathe more quickly than adults.** An infant, for instance, **breathes between 30 and 60 times per minute**, while a school-age youngster breathes between 18 and 30 times per minute.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Respiratory rates:**

 
 
• The **respiratory rate of a person** in a** resting posture is the same as their resting respiratory rate, which is 15–18 breaths per minute.**
 
• Here,** sleeping is the position that leaves you feeling the most rested**, whereas **watching TV only necessitates a few more breaths.**
 
• While engaging in** vigorous physical activity, the respiratory rate rises.**
 
• A brisk walk necessitates moving quickly, which results in a **strenuous physical workout and increased respiratory rate.**
 
• **Cycling**, on the other hand, calls for the use of more muscles than brisk walking does, which** raises the respiratory rate** needed to give the extra oxygen needed while cycling.

• **Examples of monatomic gases: **Helium (He), Radon (Rn), Neon (Ne), Xenon (Xe), Argon (Ar) and Krypton (Kr).

The majority of **Muslims** adhere to a religious restriction against borrowing interest, which is respected by these systems.

questions.question: A can complete 33(1)/(3)% of a piece of work in 10 days and B can complete one-fourth of the same work in 30 days. A, B and C together can complete the same work in 12 days. In how many days will the work be completed if A works on all days, and is assisted by B and C on alternate days, starting with B assisting A on the first day?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A completes 33 1/3% work in 10 days 

B completes 1/4th work in 30 days 

A ,B and C together completes same work in 12 days 

A works on all days 

B and C work on alternate days 

**Formula used:**

Efficiency = Total work/No. of days 

**Calculation:**

As, A completes 33 1/3% i.e.1/3rd of the total work = 10 days 

A can complete total work = 30 days 

B can complete 1/4th of the total work = 30 days 

B can complete total work = 120 days 

A, B and C can complete total work = 12 days 

Now, let us assume total work to be completed be 120 unit [ You can assume any no. but for the sake of calculation it is advised to take L.C.M of the given numbers .Here L.C.M (30,120 ,12) = 120 ]

Efficiency of A = 120/30 = 4 unit/day

Efficiency of B = 120/120 = 1unit/day

Efficiency of A + B+ C = 120/12 = 10unit/day 

Now, efficiency of C = 10 - ( 4 + 1) = 5unit/day 

Now, according to the given question, 

A works on all day and B and C on alternate days with B as starting to assist A on 1st day 

⇒ 1st day work = work done by A + work done by B 

⇒ 4 + 1 = 5 

⇒ 2nd day work = work done by A + work done by C 

⇒ 4 + 5 = 9 

⇒ 2 days work = 14 unit 

⇒ 16 days work = 14 × 8 = 112 unit 

Remaining work = 120 -112 = 8 unit 

On 17th day again 5 unit work will be done by A and B 

Now, remaining work will be = 8 - 5 = 3unit 

Now, this 3 unit will be done by A and C = 3/9 = 1/3rd day [ As efficiency of A and C is 9 unit] 

Total days taken to complete the work = 17 + 1/3 = 171/3 days 

**Hence, total days taken to complete the work is 17 1/3 days .**

options.text: The two alleles are brought together at the time of gamete formation

__

 __
 
• *The two alleles are brought together at the time of gamete formation* - The **second inheritance law** is known as the **law of segregation.** According to this law, a **pair of alleles separate** from one another **during the meiotic cell division** process, also known as **gamete formation**, resulting in **a gamete** containing **a single copy of an allele**.
 
• 
 
Four fundamental ideas form the **basis of the ****law** of segregation:

 
 
• 
 
A **gene** can take on **different allele** forms.

 
 
• 
 
**Allelic pairings** split **apart during meiosis**, resulting in each gamete having **just one allele**.

 
 
• 
 
Each **attribute** in an organism is **inherited from two** different** alleles.**

 
 
• 
 
A **pair of alleles** has two distinct alleles, **one **of which** is dominant** and the **other recessive.**

 
 
 
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is: *The two alleles are brought together at the time of gamete formation.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Statement 3__: True**
 __
 
• *Every germ cell will take one chromosome from each pair *- **Each germ cell** will accept **one chromosome** from each pair; these can come from **either the mother or the father. **When two germ cells join, they will **reestablish** the normal **amount of chromosomes** in the progeny, maintaining the **stability of the species' DNA.**
 
 
 
• **Statement 4:__ True**
 
 
• *Genes are located on chromosomes -* **Chromosomes,** which are found in the** cell nucleus**, are where **genes are found**. There are hundreds to thousands of genes on each chromosome. There are** 46 chromosomes** in all, or **23 pairs**, in each typical human cell.
